title: Intronix LogicPort adapter actions
description: Plugin-authored action profile for the LogicPort adapter. The actions are adapter-bound operations over the reverse-engineered protocol; they are not an OTDP device-class contract. Operations whose protocol destinations are open items refuse loudly with UNSUPPORTED rather than guessing a register.

configure_fpga.description: Load the FPGA bitstream from a LogicPort.ccf file through the FTDI bit-bang sequence (LogicPort-Protocol.md section 5; hardware-proven slot 0). The .ccf path comes from the action input or the LOGICPORT_CCF environment variable; the SHA-256 must be the hardware-proven digest.
configure_fpga.output_summary: slot, offset, length, bitstream_bytes, digest_verified, checksum_ok, pages_swapped, init_asserted, done, rate_command_resent, attempts

set_trigger.description: Send the two 34-bit trigger masks as usbWrite40 C1 frames (LogicPort-Protocol.md section 5a). REFUSES with UNSUPPORTED while the mask destination registers are open items.

stop.description: Send the C3 stop frame with the cached rate word (LogicPort-Protocol.md section 3.3).

resync.description: The section 3.4 resync flush: re-init, purges, 65535 and 30000 zero bytes, the 0x01 marker, purges. Up to 20 attempts.

read_samples.description: Read the trigger-position word, then ten sample-plane chunks (five planes, two ping-pong pages), de-interleave and RLE-decode per LogicPort-Protocol.md section 6. Returns packed 34-bit column states, run counts and the total sample count.
read_samples.output_summary: column_count, page_base, trigger_position, columns, runs, total_samples, trigger_column (when trigger_word given)

read_counter.description: The frequency-counter read as a typed action: one locked sweep of all four counter channels (the device's own round-robin unit), the same poll-floored select/gate/count sequences as the read frequency_a..d parameters, in the shape the execution contract sanctions for a state-changing read (a core read verb declaring state_change is excluded from procedures; a bench admits this action through its per-device allow rule). Selecting channels is a device state change, so the action declares side_effect state_change.
read_counter.output_summary: frequencies_hz (a, b, c, d), unit, quality, source
